newsitem.title: ITALY: Three tenors sing for opera houses gutted by fire.
newsitem.headline: Three tenors sing for opera houses gutted by fire.

text.p: Opera stars Luciano Pavarotti, Jose Carreras and Placido Domingo united on Tuesday for a gala "Three Tenors" concert to raise funds to help rebuild opera houses devastated by fire in Italy and Spain.

The proceeds from the concert, the latest in a series carried out by the three men, will go towards the reconstruction of Venice's La Fenice house, razed last year, and Barcelona's Liceu, damaged in 1994 and due to reopen soon.
Both Pascual Maragall, mayor of Barcelona, and Venice's mayor Massimo Cacciari attended Tuesday's concert.
"I am here to thank the Three Tenors," said Cacciari. "There are no longer any problems to rebuild the theatre but I hope the money from tonight will help the activities and management."
Other better known faces such as singer Michael Jackson, who swept in at the last minute surrounded by bodyguards, also attended the concert in Pavarotti's home town.

The pop star -- who is involved in plans for a record with Pavarotti and other singers -- shook hands with Italian film director Franco Zeffirelli sitting next to him, and waved at the crowd of more than 20,000 paying spectators.
